description: Read SEC Form 4 transactions and filing receipts. Uses the filters and plan limits of /api/v1/insiders.
name: list_insiders

outputSchema.description: A page of first-party SEC Form 4 transaction lines with measured window coverage, access and cache contracts.

access.description: Verified access mode and its row, window and request limits.

history_window.description: The current plan’s permitted EDGAR filing dates.

days.description: Free window length in UTC days.

months.description: Developer window length in calendar months.

max_rows_per_request.description: Allowed page size: 25 on Free, 100 on Developer.

max_window_days.description: Calendar days a window request may read: up to 7 on both tiers. An accession lookup can resolve a filing from the 366 calendar days ending at the latest parsed EDGAR daily index, on both tiers.

requests_per_hour_per_ip.description: Shared hourly anonymous disclosure budget per IP.

tier.description: Effective access mode. Only Developer keys page with a cursor or read more than 25 lines per request.

window_basis.description: How free-tier results are selected: caller filters apply across the requested window before the 25-line cap; an accession lookup returns one filing from the 366 calendar days ending at the latest parsed EDGAR daily index; pagination requires a Developer key.

window_rows.description: Free tier: at most 25 matching lines per request; omitted for Developer.

cache.description: Executable delivery-cache contract matching the private no-store headers.

age_header.description: No Age header is promised because origin responses are private no-store.

browser_max_age_seconds.description: Browser cache lifetime in seconds: zero.

cdn_max_age_seconds.description: Shared CDN cache lifetime in seconds: zero.

declared_max_staleness_seconds.description: Delivery staleness allowance in seconds: zero; source instants remain distinct.

policy.description: Caller-specific origin response; not reusable by a browser or shared cache.

computed_at.description: This response's computation time; not a filing, collection or index time.

anyOf.description: Measured EDGAR index coverage for the window, never smoothed, plus response-local counts.

as_of.description: Latest index or filing observation instant behind the window. A cursor pins it, so later observations wait for a new walk.

basis.description: Scope of the served population; no claim about filings outside the window.

complete.description: True only when every index day in the window was read and no listed filing is still pending.

additionalProperties.description: Lines withheld for this named reason.

held_filings.description: Listed filings held from serving, including every Form 4/A.

indexed_accessions.description: Form 4 and 4/A accessions listed on the window's EDGAR daily indexes.

measurement_state.description: When present, identifies the legacy measured whole-window coverage contract.

missing_index_dates.description: Window days with no readable EDGAR daily index.

items.description: A window day with no readable EDGAR index.

not_listed_dates.description: Window days EDGAR published no daily index for, such as weekends and holidays.

items.description: A window day EDGAR published no daily index for.

parsed_filings.description: Listed filings parsed and available for serving.

reason.description: Why complete is true or false, exactly as measured.

rows_held.description: Window lines withheld from this response because they failed the identity or receipt contract.

rows_returned.description: Lines returned in this response after caller filters; not a warehouse total.

start_date.description: First calendar day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

through_date.description: Latest parsed EDGAR daily index date; the window ends here.

window_days.description: Calendar days read, ending at through_date.

window_lines.description: Served lines in the whole window before access limits and caller filters.

anyOf.description: Bounded-page receipt measurements with explicit null whole-window coverage totals.

as_of.description: Latest index or filing observation instant behind the window. A cursor pins it, so later observations wait for a new walk.

basis.description: Scope of the served population; no claim about filings outside the window.

candidate_rows.description: Stored candidates hydrated in this bounded page before receipt holds and post-projection filters.

complete.description: Whole-window filing completeness is unmeasured by this bounded read.

additionalProperties.description: Lines withheld for this named reason.

held_filings.description: Whole-window held filing count is unmeasured.

indexed_accessions.description: Whole-window indexed accession count is unmeasured.

measurement_scope.description: Receipt admission and candidate counts describe only this page.

measurement_state.description: The whole window's filing and transaction totals remain unmeasured.

missing_index_dates.description: Window days with no readable EDGAR daily index.

items.description: A window day with no readable EDGAR index.

not_listed_dates.description: Window days EDGAR published no daily index for, such as weekends and holidays.

items.description: A window day EDGAR published no daily index for.

parsed_filings.description: Whole-window available filing count is unmeasured.

pending_filings.description: Whole-window pending filing count is unmeasured.

reason.description: This response measures one bounded page, not the whole EDGAR window.

refused_filings.description: Whole-window refused filing count is unmeasured.

rows_held.description: Window lines withheld from this response because they failed the identity or receipt contract.

rows_returned.description: Lines returned in this response after caller filters; not a warehouse total.

start_date.description: First calendar day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

through_date.description: Latest parsed EDGAR daily index date; the window ends here.

window_days.description: Calendar days read, ending at through_date.

window_lines.description: Whole-window served transaction line count is unmeasured.

coverage.description: Explicit measured whole-window coverage or bounded-page measurements with unmeasured totals null.

data.description: Served Form 4 transaction lines in this page.

items.description: One served SEC Form 4 transaction line from Veridion's first-party EDGAR warehouse.

accession.description: SEC accession number of the Form 4 filing.

content_hash.description: SHA256 hex of the UTF-8 JSON of every served field except content_hash and provenance, keys sorted at every level, no whitespace.

content_hash_basis.description: Named hash recipe. Collection and parse clocks are provenance and never change content_hash.

conversion_or_exercise_price.description: Conversion or exercise price as filed.

underlying_security_shares.description: Underlying shares as filed, decimal text.

derivative.description: Table II derivative terms as filed; null for Table I lines.

filing_date.description: EDGAR filing date, YYYY-MM-DD; not the transaction date or Veridion's collection date.

footnotes.description: Footnotes the filing attaches to this line, one entry per reference.

items.description: One footnote reference on this line.

field_locator.description: XML path of the field the footnote is attached to.

id.description: Footnote identifier as printed (for example F1).

form_type.description: SEC form type. Only original Form 4 filings are served; Form 4/A amendments are held, not served.

issuer.description: The issuer exactly as identified by the filing.

cik.description: Issuer Central Index Key as filed, ten digits.

name.description: Issuer name as printed in the filing XML.

fetched_at.description: When Veridion retrieved that SEC directory, UTC.

printed_ticker.description: The ticker exactly as SEC's company directory prints it.

sha256.description: SHA256 of the SEC directory bytes Veridion retrieved.

source_url.description: SEC company directory URL the confirmation was read from.

ticker.description: Printed symbol normalized (uppercase; '-' and '/' become '.') and confirmed for this CIK by SEC's company directory.

ticker_mapping.description: SEC's own confirmation that the printed symbol belongs to this issuer CIK, or null. A ticker is never inferred from a name.

trading_symbol.description: Issuer trading symbol exactly as printed in the filing; null when the filing omits it.

line.description: One-based line within its table, in filing order.

line_id.description: Stable line identity: accession, ownership table and the one-based line within that table, as printed in the filing XML.

ownership_table.description: Form 4 table the line is printed in: Table I (non_derivative) or Table II (derivative).

provenance.description: Collection evidence. This response's computed_at never replaces these clocks.

first_observed_at.description: When Veridion first observed the filing, UTC; outside content_hash.

parser_version.description: Parser version that produced the line.

recorded_at.description: When Veridion recorded this parse, UTC.

receipt.description: The government's own record behind this line, with exact hashes for independent re-verification.

document_byte_length.description: Byte length of that ownership XML.

document_sha256.description: SHA256 of the exact ownership XML bytes Veridion parsed.

hash_kind.description: document: the primary XML was hashed as downloaded. embedded_xml: the XML was extracted from the downloaded submission, then hashed.

primary_document_url.description: SEC EDGAR URL of the filing's primary ownership XML.

primary_document_verified.description: True only when Veridion downloaded and hashed the primary document URL itself; false when the XML was read from the submission.

source_byte_length.description: Byte length of the bytes downloaded from receipt.url.

source_sha256.description: SHA256 of the bytes downloaded from receipt.url.

url.description: SEC EDGAR URL of the bytes Veridion downloaded; the full submission when hash_kind is embedded_xml.

xml_locator.description: Exact element path of this line inside the ownership XML.

reporting_owners.description: Every reporting owner on the filing, in filing order. Owners are filing-level: the form does not attribute a line to one owner of a joint filing.

items.description: One reporting owner and the relationship boxes exactly as filed.

cik.description: Reporting owner Central Index Key as filed.

director.description: Director box as filed; null when the filing leaves it unstated.

name.description: Reporting owner name as printed in the filing.

officer.description: Officer box as filed; null when unstated.

officer_title.description: Officer title as printed, or null.

other.description: Other relationship box as filed; null when unstated.

other_text.description: Other relationship text as printed, or null.

ten_percent_owner.description: 10% owner box as filed; null when unstated.

rule_10b5_1.description: The filing's Rule 10b5-1 checkbox as filed; null when the form does not carry it.

security_title.description: Security title as printed on this line.

transaction.description: The transaction line exactly as filed, plus Veridion's code classification.

classification.description: Veridion classification of the filed code and footnotes. open_market_buy requires code P with no plan or non-market footnote; unresolved cases are labelled, never guessed.

code.description: SEC transaction code as filed (for example P, S, A, M, F).

date.description: Transaction date as filed, YYYY-MM-DD; null when absent or not a calendar date (see value_exceptions).

direct_indirect.description: Direct (D) or indirect (I) ownership as filed.

nature_of_ownership.description: Nature of indirect ownership as printed (for example a trust), or null.

price_per_share.description: Price per share exactly as filed, decimal text; null when absent or given only in a footnote.

shares.description: Shares or units exactly as filed, decimal text, never a float.

shares_owned_after.description: Shares beneficially owned after the transaction, exactly as filed.

value_exceptions.description: Fields served as null because the filing states them only in a footnote or prints them in an unreadable form. Absent fields are not listed.

items.description: One value served as null for a stated reason.

field.description: Filing field served as null on this line.

raw.description: The printed text for an unparseable value, exactly as filed; null for footnote_only.

state.description: footnote_only: the filing gives this value only in a footnote. unparseable: the printed value is not in the field's expected form.

basis.description: Explanation of the retained warehouse population, independent measurement clocks and unknown serving counts.

computed_at.description: Null when no current warehouse census could be validated.

continuous_coverage.description: Proven continuous coverage is not measured. Always null: minimum and maximum collected-history dates do not establish continuous historical coverage.

dataset.description: Fixed dataset identity for the retained SEC Form 4 historical warehouse observations.

detail.description: Plain-English reason the saved history measurement could not be read or validated. Does not assert whether the census job ran.

form_type.description: Original Form 4 only; Form 4/A amendments are excluded from this history census.

history_basis.description: The ranges describe currently available original filings in the measured quarters, rather than continuously complete collection.

history_end.description: Compatibility alias for warehouse_history_end across the measured quarters; null when unavailable or no original filing was parsed.

history_start.description: Compatibility alias for warehouse_history_start across the measured quarters; null when unavailable or no original filing was parsed.

measured_at.description: Oldest retained observation time for this population, in UTC; an empty quarterly census uses its assembly time.

quarters.description: One to 48 retained quarterly receipts when measured, or null when unavailable. Counts come from bounded independent observations, not one database snapshot.

source_system.description: Government system of record for these index and filing receipts.

state.description: measured identifies validated retained quarterly observations; unavailable withholds clocks, ranges and quarters when that evidence cannot be validated.

warehouse_history_end.description: Latest filing date among parsed original Form 4 filings in this reported population; null when none were parsed. This is warehouse availability, not served history.

warehouse_history_start.description: Earliest filing date among parsed original Form 4 filings in this reported population; null when none were parsed. This is warehouse availability, not served history.

warehouse_measurement.description: Null when no current warehouse census could be validated; no counts or dates are inferred.

basis.description: Explanation of the retained warehouse population, independent measurement clocks and unknown serving counts.

computed_at.description: Actual statement instant of the attached warehouse_measurement, or null when that census is unavailable. A legacy quarterly observation timestamp is never substituted.

continuous_coverage.description: Proven continuous coverage is not measured. Always null: minimum and maximum collected-history dates do not establish continuous historical coverage.

dataset.description: Fixed dataset identity for the retained SEC Form 4 historical warehouse observations.

detail.description: Null when the saved history measurement was read and validated.

form_type.description: Original Form 4 only; Form 4/A amendments are excluded from this history census.

history_basis.description: The ranges describe currently available original filings in the measured quarters, rather than continuously complete collection.

history_end.description: Compatibility alias for warehouse_history_end across the measured quarters; null when unavailable or no original filing was parsed.

history_start.description: Compatibility alias for warehouse_history_start across the measured quarters; null when unavailable or no original filing was parsed.

measured_at.description: Oldest retained observation time for this population, in UTC; an empty quarterly census uses its assembly time.

quarters.description: One to 48 retained quarterly receipts when measured, or null when unavailable. Counts come from bounded independent observations, not one database snapshot.

captured_unparsed_filings.description: Number of indexed accessions whose retained warehouse observation state is captured_unparsed; unit: filings, disjoint from parsed, held, refused and pending.

end_date.description: Inclusive last filing date in this bounded quarterly census, in UTC calendar days.

held_filings.description: Number of indexed accessions whose retained warehouse observation state is held with a recorded reason; unit: filings, disjoint from the other outcome counts.

index_final.description: Whether the retained index was observed after quarter end and marked complete; false does not imply that all filings are collected.

index_observed_at.description: UTC observation timestamp on the retained SEC index receipt, no later than this quarter measurement.

index_scope.description: full_quarter means start_date and end_date span the entire calendar quarter; bounded_window means a proper subset.

index_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA256 of the retained SEC quarterly index bytes.

index_url.description: Official SEC quarterly Form 4 index receipt used for this census, limited by start_date and end_date.

indexed_filings.description: Number of distinct original Form 4 accessions listed in the retained index between start_date and end_date; unit: filings. Amendments are excluded.

measured_at.description: Oldest retained observation time for this population, in UTC; an empty quarterly census uses its assembly time.

parsed_filings.description: Number of indexed accessions whose retained warehouse observation state is parsed, including holdings-only filings; unit: filings, not served transactions.

pending_filings.description: Number of indexed accessions whose retained warehouse observation state is pending; unit: filings, disjoint from captured_unparsed, parsed, held and refused.

quarter.description: Calendar quarter of the retained original SEC Form 4 index; the label alone does not establish complete or continuous coverage.

refused_filings.description: Number of indexed accessions whose retained warehouse observation state is refused with a recorded reason; unit: filings, disjoint from the other outcome counts.

served_filings.description: Number of indexed parsed filings in a retained serving measurement for this quarter; unit: filings. Null when serving was not measured, including the current history producer.

served_history_end.description: Latest filing date in the retained quarterly serving measurement; null when serving is unmeasured or contains no served filings.

served_history_start.description: Earliest filing date in the retained quarterly serving measurement; null when serving is unmeasured or contains no served filings.

served_transactions.description: Number of qualifying transaction rows from indexed filings in the retained quarterly serving measurement; unit: transactions. Null when serving was not measured; never inferred from parsed filings.

start_date.description: Inclusive first filing date in this bounded quarterly census, in UTC calendar days.

warehouse_history_end.description: Latest filing date among parsed original Form 4 filings in this reported population; null when none were parsed. This is warehouse availability, not served history.

warehouse_history_start.description: Earliest filing date among parsed original Form 4 filings in this reported population; null when none were parsed. This is warehouse availability, not served history.

source_system.description: Government system of record for these index and filing receipts.

state.description: measured identifies validated retained quarterly observations; unavailable withholds clocks, ranges and quarters when that evidence cannot be validated.

warehouse_history_end.description: Latest filing date among parsed original Form 4 filings in this reported population; null when none were parsed. This is warehouse availability, not served history.

warehouse_history_start.description: Earliest filing date among parsed original Form 4 filings in this reported population; null when none were parsed. This is warehouse availability, not served history.

available.description: Current original filings whose warehouse serving_state is available; API row-level receipt qualification still applies separately.

basis.description: Current nonsuperseded original Form 4 filings retained from sec_edgar; this census does not assert that every index-listed filing was collected.

computed_at.description: Actual database statement instant of this current warehouse census, normalized to UTC microseconds; not an index receipt observation time.

continuous_coverage.description: Proven continuous coverage is not measured. Always null because collected-history date bounds cannot establish continuous historical coverage.

filings.description: Count of current, nonsuperseded first-party original SEC Form 4 filings in this warehouse population, including available, held and refused filings; amendments are excluded.

first_filing_date.description: Earliest filing date among currently available original SEC Form 4 filings in this population; null when none are available. This is warehouse availability, not a served API date or proof of complete history.

held.description: Current original filings whose warehouse serving_state is held.

last_filing_date.description: Latest filing date among currently available original SEC Form 4 filings in this population; null when none are available.

quarters.description: Current warehouse counts grouped by filing quarter from the same statement. These are not quarterly index receipts and contain no inferred index denominator or served transaction count.

available.description: Current original filings whose warehouse serving_state is available; API row-level receipt qualification still applies separately.

refused.description: Current original filings whose warehouse serving_state is refused.

dataset.description: Fixed dataset identity for the retained SEC Form 4 historical warehouse observations.

detail.description: Null when the current warehouse census was read and validated.

form_type.description: Original Form 4 only; Form 4/A amendments are excluded from this history census.

history_basis.description: Date bounds come only from available current original SEC Form 4 warehouse filings, without a quarterly index denominator or claim of continuous coverage.

history_end.description: Compatibility alias for warehouse_history_end, the latest available original filing date in this warehouse census; null when none are available.

history_start.description: Compatibility alias for warehouse_history_start, the earliest available original filing date in this warehouse census; null when none are available.

measured_at.description: For the current_available_original_filings basis, the actual statement instant of warehouse_measurement, equal to computed_at.

quarters.description: Null because retained quarterly index receipt measurements are unavailable. warehouse_measurement.quarters contains current warehouse counts under a separate explicit basis.

warehouse_history_end.description: Latest available original SEC Form 4 filing date in the current warehouse census; null when no available originals exist.

warehouse_history_start.description: Earliest available original SEC Form 4 filing date in the current warehouse census; not an API served date or continuous coverage claim.

warehouse_measurement.description: Validated statement-stamped census of current original SEC Form 4 warehouse filings. Required for this history basis; counts are never inferred from legacy or daily index observations.

insiders_history.description: Collected SEC Form 4 history under its stated evidence basis, with independent computed_at and warehouse counts. Proven continuous coverage remains unmeasured; this metadata does not extend the served API window.

page.description: Keyset pagination within one pinned EDGAR window.

has_more.description: More matching lines exist than this response returns; receipt holds can leave a short page. Reported truthfully on every tier; only a Developer key receives a cursor. On an accession lookup it means the filing has more lines than limit.

limit.description: Requested page size under the verified access mode.

next_cursor.description: Signed, query-bound position and serving revision for the next Developer page, or null. Always null on free access and on accession lookups. Evidence changes require a new walk.

order.description: Filing date descending, then accession, ownership table and line ascending; not a ranking.

version.description: Served Disclosure API contract version, also sent as X-API-Version.
